verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls docs cover GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-out, with forwarding rules such as "Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present". That handles the suppression side by blocking data flow to destinations, and Consent Filters plus a GDPR/CCPA compliance page corroborate it. Nothing in the pack shows processing user deletion or erasure requests, or forwarding those requests to connected destinations. Missing for 10: a documented deletion/erasure request workflow or API, forwarding of deletion requests to downstream partners, request status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
